title: 성인식
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Bubblegum Pop. Female vocals with a bright, processed tone. The arrangement features a syncopated synth bass with a short decay, layered with a four-on-the-floor kick drum and crisp electronic claps on the backbeat. A high-pitched, staccato synth lead plays a repetitive melodic hook. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of B Major. Production includes heavy sidechain compression on the pads and vocal tuning effects. A rhythmic pluck synth provides harmonic movement in the mid-range.
